findings.text: bats_execute now sets PATH="$BATS_SAVED_PATH", but the backed-up path variable is BATS_PATH and BATS_SAVED_PATH is never defined in this change. If it is unset, PATH becomes empty, so every command run through bats_execute (e.g. `bats_execute sort`) fails with 'command not found' instead of running with the saved PATH.
